It seemed like a good place, but I made an appointment for a filling on Saturday morning because I was experiencing severe toothache. They scheduled an appointment for 3:00 a.m., but upon arrival they said their doctor couldn't do anything and only had time for a diagnosis. As it turns out, all other clinics are open until 5:00 p.m., and most are closed tomorrow because it's Sunday, and then there's a holiday until Friday.
I wasted my time and ended up with 4-5 days of severe toothache.
